p: Mitchell will have a significant role in the RB room given the injuries.
He is healthy again and Sirianni singled him out, which makes him a likely volume back if Barkley is limited or out.
I was really excited about Elijah throughout camp.
Mitchell is available as RB depth and could step in when needed.
A deep-league option if the RB injuries persist.
I was really pleased with how he was looking as well.
